{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(penguins.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values per column:')
print(penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nNumber of duplicate rows:', penguins.duplicated().sum())

# Check the distributions of the two variables
print('\nSummary stats for flipper_length_mm:')
print(penguins['flipper_length_mm'].describe())

print('\nSummary stats for body_mass_g:')
print(penguins['body_mass_g'].describe())"}
